entries.zh: 学习；模仿
entries.en: to learn; to imitate

entries.zh: 学习道理；修学道（习道之学）
entries.en: to learn the doctrine / the Way; to study moral learning

entries.zh: 学习技艺；学业
entries.en: to learn a trade / craft; one's studies
entries.notes: 西语栏多字潦草残缺，off.o 依语境推为 officio（技艺/行当）。

entries.zh: 学习礼节；学礼
entries.en: to learn courtesy / manners
entries.notes: cortesia/capcia 二读存疑，礼字与四栏互证为主。

entries.zh: 效仿；效法善行
entries.en: to imitate what is good
entries.notes: bien/buena 二读存疑，语义以'效'字定。

entries.zh: 效仿善行；照样学好的样子（二字疑为由/尤）
entries.en: to imitate the good; to follow a good example
entries.notes: 汉字由/尤及 bien/buena 二读均存疑。

entries.zh: 学习；温习功课
entries.en: to study, to learn a lesson

entries.zh: 学做官；学习为官之道
entries.en: to study in order to become a mandarin; to learn official service
entries.notes: 西语 'à p. mandarin' 推为 para mandarín，缩写依赖推断。

entries.zh: 从经验中学乖；吃一堑长一智
entries.en: to learn wisdom by experience; to become shrewd through trial

entries.zh: 学做工夫；学手艺
entries.en: to learn to work / a manual skill

entries.zh: 学做某事；学着做
entries.en: to learn to do something; to practise making

entries.zh: （却巧）死记硬学、似懂非懂地学
entries.en: to learn by rote, attending without understanding
entries.notes: 西语尾段残缺，语义依汉字'却巧'及首句 curio-sidad 推定。

entries.zh: （却巧样）装出巧学之样；作学巧的姿态（带名词标记 vn）
entries.en: a look of learned cleverness; to affect having learned
entries.notes: 西语尾词难辨，样字及小字 vn 依赖推断。

entries.zh: （却巧话）学着巧说话；仿学言语
entries.en: to learn to speak by attending closely; clever talk learned by imitation
entries.notes: 西语尾词难辨，话字四栏互证。

entries.zh: 学习技艺；学一门手艺
entries.en: to learn any trade or craft
entries.notes: 藝字读音 ge/gay 二读存疑。

entries.zh: 所学；学会做什么就做什么
entries.en: what one has learned; to do what one has been taught
entries.notes: 所字读音 so/soi/sor 存疑。

entries.zh: 学徒；徒弟（师仔）
entries.en: apprentice

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕投掷（据汉字'擲'）
entries.en: 〔source damaged; gloss uncertain〕to throw, to toss
entries.notes: 西语尾词涂黑、汉字擲/捃及读音均存疑，仅汉字可据。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕预备；作准备（据汉字疑榛/梀）
entries.en: 〔source damaged; gloss uncertain〕to prepare, to get ready
entries.notes: 西语 aprestar 语境示'预备'，汉字与读音均有异读。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕相互预备／彼此设防（相榛）
entries.en: 〔source damaged; gloss uncertain〕to prepare against one another; to block each other
entries.notes: 西语中后段难辨，榛字异读，仅'相'字与 siǒ 可据。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕勒紧；强制约束（勒）
entries.en: 〔source damaged; gloss uncertain〕to constrain, to bind tightly
entries.notes: 西语栏多字难辨（Apremurad/apresionad 二读），小字斜插记号难辨。

entries.zh: 勒写；赶写、匆忙书写
entries.en: to write in haste, to scribble in a hurry
entries.notes: 寫字三读存疑，但西语 apresurad en escriuir 与读音 guiěn çiè 互证较稳。
